development_leakage_boundary: Designed from existing round-2 parameter files only; no new COMSOL background solve, auxiliary solve, full target solve, target field read or target conductivity read was performed. Geometry-only area estimates are not electrical predictions.
adoption_gate: Parent task may adopt this list only after development methodology is frozen. Background predictions at sigma_f=1 and 10 S/m must be saved before corresponding full target solves or reads. This candidate list itself is not prediction_method_frozen.json.
coordinate_convention: Input x,z in mm, COMSOL x,y correspond to physical x,z; theta=+60 deg counterclockwise from +x; all electrical calculations in SI.
background_comparability_limit: Use each candidate own background. All have analytic high/low area 7200/7200 mm2; flat cases also share analytic series/parallel directional responses, but replacement areas differ among internal cases and some waves. Do not call all twelve a strictly matched causal comparison.

finite_old_parameter_comparison.scope: 19 round-2 nominal full-length-60 uncut records with fixed ellipse; repeats by mesh/conductivity excluded by filename, then actual parameters checked; same-material partition boundaries removed before direct list comparison. No hashes or all-project result audit.
finite_old_parameter_comparison.mirror_exclusion: All cases share bottom-low/top-high 20 mm buffers, excluding z reflection and half-turn equivalence. x reflection changes sine amplitude signs (none of the new wave profiles has a negative partner); for flat cases x reflection leaves each profile itself. Fixed ellipse angle 60 deg also excludes diagonal symmetries of the square.
